notes.title: Burst Squad New Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Burst Squad Update![/h1]
[b]Hello, Dear players. I'd like to introduce you to a new update. To give you a better experience. As our team, we have added a new map to the Burst Squad game. And we made a few minor bug fixes.[/b]
We'll be here with better updates in the future. We work to give you a good experience.
